payload.text: hv, 2026-10-17 evening: ST0008 AC-6.5's route is (a), as vc recommended: the WSL job installs Intent's Linux musl binary from Intent's GitHub release with a read-only token held as a devbin repository secret, INTENT_READ_TOKEN (a fine-grained token with Contents: read on matthewsinclair/intent only), which hv creates; dc builds the install step before the smoke list, and wsl-smoke.sh then asserts the critic gate passes on the intent/ fixture. Not (b) Homebrew inside WSL, not (c) waiting for public. Not put to hv again.
